introduction:
In West Bengal, the Caste Certificate is issued by the Block Development Officer (BDO) / Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) for SC and ST applicants. For OBC (OBC-A and OBC-B), the certificate is issued by the Backward Classes Welfare Department.

Applications can be made online via the e-District West Bengal Portal or offline at the BDO / SDO office. SC/ST certificates are issued under the Revenue Department while OBC requires additional income verification.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Purpose: Applying for a Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC) in West Bengal.
  • Official Authority: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal.
  • Website Used: castcertificatewb.gov.in
  • Process Type: Hybrid (Online application followed by mandatory offline physical document submission).
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Note: Keep all documents ready before starting the online application.
Personal & Identity Proofs
  • Photograph: Recent passport-size photograph of the applicant (Maximum size: 150kb).
  • Proof of Age: e.g., Aadhaar Card, Birth Certificate, Admit Card.
  • Photo Identity Document: e.g., Aadhaar Card, Voter ID.
  • Proof of Citizenship: e.g., Aadhaar Card.
Residence & Other Details
  • Proof of Residence in West Bengal: e.g., Aadhaar Card.
  • Proof of Local Residence: e.g., Aadhaar Card, Voter ID.
  • Voter ID Card number: Applicant's own, or Father's/Mother's if the applicant is a minor.
  • Details of a Blood Relative's Caste Certificate: (if applicable/available).
  • Referees: Names and full addresses of two local referees (neighbors or people from the local area).
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online via BCW Department Portal

The online process registers your application data and generates the mandatory physical submission forms.

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1: Visit Portal: Visit the official website: castcertificatewb.gov.in.
  2. Step 2: Choose Category: Click on "Apply for SC/ST" or "Apply for OBC" based on your category.
  3. Step 3: Select Location: Select your District, Sub-Division, Municipality/Block, and Gram Panchayat/Ward.
  4. Step 4: Select Caste: Select the exact Sub-caste/Tribe/Community from the drop-down list.
  5. Step 5: Fill Personal Details: Enter personal details (Name, Father's Name, Mobile Number, Date of Birth, Place of Birth) and your present and permanent address.
  6. Step 6 (Blood Relation): If you are applying using a blood relative's caste certificate, enter the certificate holder's name, certificate number, date of issue, issuing authority, and relation to the applicant.
  7. Step 7 (Referees): Enter the names and addresses of two local referees. Click "Save and Continue".
  8. Step 8 (Document Details): Upload the applicant's photograph. Select the document type for age, identity, citizenship, and residence proofs from the dropdowns and enter their respective document numbers.
  9. Step 9: Submit: Enter the Voter ID number, type the Captcha, and click Submit.
  10. Step 10: Acknowledgement: Your application will be submitted successfully, and an Application Number will be generated.
  11. Offline Visit: This is mandatory. You must click the provided links to download and print the filled-up Application Form and the Acknowledgement Slip.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Physical Document Submission (Offline Step)

While the application must be initiated online, the process cannot be completed without an offline physical visit:

  • After generating the online application, take a printout of the Application Form and the Acknowledgement Slip.
  • Attach self-attested photocopies of all the documents you referenced in the online form (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Birth Certificate, Blood relative's caste certificate, etc.).
  • Submit this complete physical set of documents to your local Block Development Office (BDO) if you reside in a rural area, or the Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) / Municipality Office if you reside in an urban area.
afterApplying:
After Applying — What Next?

Keep Slip Safe

Keep the printed Acknowledgement Slip safely, as it contains your Application Number.

Track Status

You can track the status of your application online by visiting the portal and clicking on "Application Check" under your respective category tab.

Download Certificate

Once the physical verification is successful and the certificate is approved and issued, you do not need to visit the office again. The digitally signed Caste Certificate can be downloaded directly from the portal by clicking "Download Certificate".
